about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Kotopita (Greek Chicken and Feta Filo Pie)
recipes.summary: Crisp, buttery filo layers around a creamy filling of chicken, feta, ricotta and dill.
steps: Poach the chicken in the water at a gentle simmer for 15 minutes, until cooked through. Lift out and shred finely.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, until soft. Mix in a bowl with the chicken, feta, ricotta, eggs, dill and pepper.

Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Brush a 20cm x 30cm dish with butter and layer in half the filo, brushing each sheet with butter. Spread over the filling and cover with the rest of the filo, brushing between sheets.
Score the top into squares and bake for 40 minutes, until deep golden and puffed. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the centre and the pie must be hot all the way through. Refrigerate leftovers within an hour.
Keep unused filo covered with a damp cloth so it does not dry out.

recipes.title: Yiouvarlakia (Greek Meatballs in Egg and Lemon Sauce)
recipes.summary: Soft rice-and-herb meatballs poached in broth, finished with a silky egg and lemon sauce.
steps: Mix the mince, rice, onion, parsley, 1 egg, oil, salt and pepper and roll into 16 walnut-sized balls.
Bring the stock to a gentle simmer in a wide pot, add the meatballs and cook covered over low heat for 40 minutes, until the rice is tender and the meatballs are cooked through.
Whisk the 2 eggs and lemon juice in a bowl, then slowly whisk in 1 cup of hot stock. Take the pot off the heat and stir the egg mixture in gently.
Return to very low heat for 2 minutes, until the sauce thickens slightly. Do not let it boil or it will curdle.
notes: Food safety: meatballs must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside. The sauce is thickened by the heat of the stock, so keep it just below a boil until the eggs are set.

recipes.title: Arroz al Horno (Spanish Baked Rice with Pork Ribs and Chorizo)
recipes.summary: A Valencian tray of rice baked in stock with pork ribs, chorizo, chickpeas and tomato.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brown the ribs and chorizo in the oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the tomato and paprika and cook for 3 minutes, until thick. Stir in the rice and chickpeas for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock mixed with the saffron, nestle the garlic on top and bring to a simmer, until bubbling across the pan. Do not stir again.
Bake uncovered for 40 minutes, until the stock is absorbed and the surface is crusty. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C; the ribs should be tender at the end. Cool leftover rice within an hour and refrigerate.

recipes.title: Hachis Parmentier (French Beef and Potato Pie)
recipes.summary: Savoury beef mince under buttery mashed potato with a golden gruyere crust.
steps: Boil the potato in salted water for 18 minutes, until tender, then drain, mash with the butter and milk and season.

Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and broken up. Stir in the tomato paste and flour for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick. Tip into a baking dish and heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Cover with the mash, rake the top with a fork and scatter with the gruyere. Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
notes: Food safety: the mince filling must reach 75°C and be piping hot before it is topped. Cool leftovers within an hour.
Good for the freezer for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Sausage and Broccolini
recipes.summary: Pugliese-style ear-shaped pasta with browned Italian sausage, garlic, chilli and tender broccolini.

items: 2 bunch broccolini, cut into short lengths

steps: Cook the pasta in plenty of salted boiling water for 10 minutes, adding the broccolini for the last 3 minutes, until the pasta is al dente. Reserve a mug of cooking water, then drain.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the sausage, breaking it into chunks, for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute, then toss through the pasta, broccolini, lemon zest and enough cooking water to make a glossy sauce.
notes: Food safety: sausage must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside.

recipes.title: Swiss Brown Mushroom Risotto with Thyme
recipes.summary: Creamy arborio rice stirred with browned mushrooms, white wine, thyme and a little butter.
steps: Heat half the oil in a large pan over high heat and cook the mushrooms for 6 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Add the remaining oil, onion and garlic and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, until soft. Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often, for 20 minutes, until the rice is creamy and tender with a slight bite. Add the thyme and mushrooms halfway.
Take off the heat and beat in the butter and cheese. Rest, covered, for 2 minutes.
notes: Keep the stock at a simmer in a second pot so the rice cooks evenly.

recipes.title: Enfrijoladas (Oaxacan Bean-Sauced Tortillas with Eggs)
recipes.summary: Corn tortillas dipped in smooth black bean sauce and topped with eggs, crumbled cheese and avocado.
steps: Blend the beans with the water, garlic, cumin and a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into a wide pan and simmer for 8 minutes, until thickened to a thin gravy.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side, until soft and pliable. Dip each in the bean sauce, fold into quarters and arrange on plates.
Fry the eggs in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Top each plate with an egg, extra sauce, feta, avocado and coriander.
notes: Food safety: fry the eggs until the whites are fully set; skip runny yolks for children, older adults and anyone pregnant.

recipes.title: Pollo a la Brasa-Style Roast Chicken with Potatoes
recipes.summary: Peruvian-spiced chicken with cumin, paprika, garlic and soy, roasted with crisp potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Mix the soy, oil, vinegar, garlic, cumin, paprika and oregano into a paste and rub it over the chicken, working it under the skin.
Toss the potato with a spoonful of the paste and a pinch of salt in a large roasting tin and sit the chicken on top, skin side up.
Roast for 50 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the potatoes golden.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes and serve with the lime wedges.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
